scientific_integrity: The local blow-up calculation and all 16 linear constraint systems are supplied. The included script checks ranks over Q and finite fields of characteristics 2, 3, and 5; it is a finite algebraic check, not a proof for all characteristics.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns only subsets of the four coordinate corners on P1 x P1; no claim is made for arbitrary centers or higher cohomology.
title: Section dimensions for tangent fields on corner blow-ups of the quadric surface
